Branch `claude/issue-7671-7669-7670-attachments-checklist`; session `session_01GZKbx4xyF7U5WXj6ch49BM`; `mode:cloud`, `model: opus`. This card's half: land the runtime-provisioned scratch fixture (`qa_vault`/`qa_shared`/`qa_nofiles` + two personas) as a permanent checklist-side fixture (fixtures/provisioning blocks), so the area's authz core stops re-provisioning every run. ⛔ Scope note in the pack claim: checklist-side only; if the right landing turns out to be showcase seed code, stop and fork-report rather than breaching the surface.

Implemented as part of the packed unit — **full os-dev report lives on #7671** (objectstack-ai/objectstack#7671, the `os-dev-report` comment). Draft PR: #7716, branch `claude/issue-7671-7669-7670-attachments-checklist`, first lines `Fixes #7671` / `Fixes #7669` / `Fixes #7670`.

**The fork-report condition did NOT trigger.** The run's provisioning was pure runtime HTTP against a live app, touching no repo file, so the correct landing really is checklist-side — no showcase seed code was written, and the scope note was not breached.

**This card's half.** A new **area-level** `fixtures` block on `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/attachments-storage.json`, carrying one recipe (`qa-scratch-authz`) as an ordered, replayable call sequence:

1. `POST /api/v1/packages` — scratch package
2. `PUT /meta/objects/qa_vault?package=…` — `sharingModel: 'private'` + `enable.files: true`
3. `PUT /meta/objects/qa_shared?package=…` — `public_read` + `enable.files: true`
4. `PUT /meta/objects/qa_nofiles?package=…` — files deliberately omitted (the `FILES_DISABLED` probe target)
5. two fresh sign-ups, `sys_user` ids resolved system-side
6. `sys_user_permission_set` bindings — A read-but-not-edit, B baseline-only

Every call is **grounded at file:line rather than transcribed from the run narrative**: the install body `{ manifest, enableOnInstall?, overwrite? }` is pinned in `packages/client/src/client.test.ts:2144-2166`; `sharingModel`'s enum and `enable.files`' default-false live at `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:1827` and `:281`; `?package=` is read as `query.package` and threaded to `saveMetaItem` at `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts:262,319`; the `PUT` is `manage_metadata`-gated per ADR-0066 D1 (#6603), which is now a stated `requires` because a bare session is not enough.

Two gaps are recorded rather than papered over: the SDK's `meta.saveItem` does **not** send `?package=` (`packages/client/src/index.ts:701-707`), so steps 2-4 must be raw HTTP or the objects land outside the package and the teardown misses them; and the two personas' exact permission-set payloads were never captured by run #7635, so step 6 is specified by **outcome** with an instruction to verify the split independently before scoring any storage clause.

The recipe is written **once** at area level and referenced by items via `fixtures.provisioning.use`, so three (soon four) items cannot drift into three copies of the same sequence. `download-authz-both-sides`, `read-inherits-parent-rls` and `attach-requires-parent-edit` each opt in, restate their stale "not demonstrable on stock seeds" `knownGaps` as closed-by-recipe with the dogfood pin (`att_secret`) named as the fallback, and bump revision with history. `attach-requires-parent-edit` additionally names `qa_nofiles` as the `FILES_DISABLED` probe target instead of `showcase_account`, which is files-disabled only incidentally and would go green for the wrong reason if that ever changed.

One non-blocking note is raised for the PM in the report and the PR body: the area-level `fixtures` shape is new to this ledger and `README.md`'s "Item anatomy" documents `fixtures` only per-item. The block self-documents via a `$comment`, but `README.md` was outside this pack's declared file surface, so it was deliberately left alone rather than edited on the side.
